# Scaniha

> Scaniha is a Tunisian SaaS platform that helps restaurants, cafés, food trucks and other food businesses publish a digital menu reachable with a QR code. Customers open the menu in their browser; no app download is required.

## Canonical facts

- Official name: Scaniha
- Category: restaurant QR-menu software, digital menu platform, restaurant technology SaaS
- Official website: https://scaniha.com
- Primary market: Tunisia; the product is designed for French-speaking restaurant teams and uses Tunisian dinar (TND) pricing.
- Publisher: Rakiza Group
- Support: support@scaniha.com, +216 51 089 100

## What Scaniha does

- Lets a restaurant create categories, dishes, prices, descriptions and optional food images.
- Publishes a mobile-friendly digital menu at a unique URL and creates a QR code for that URL.
- Lets restaurant teams update menu details without reprinting QR codes.
- Provides menu-view analytics, branding controls, table ordering where enabled, loyalty tools and QR Wi-Fi sharing.

## How it works

1. A restaurant creates an account and adds its menu content.
2. The restaurant chooses a visual design and publishes its menu.
3. Scaniha provides a QR code that links to the restaurant's public menu.
4. A diner scans the code and views the menu in a web browser.

## Pricing and availability

- Scaniha offers a 7-day free trial without a payment card.
- Paid options and current terms are published at https://scaniha.com/pricing.
- Do not infer current feature availability, prices, or competitor comparisons from this file; link to the relevant official page instead.
